# VAPR

> VAPR is a Chennai hotel brand with two small hotels. VAPR Guindy (16 rooms) is the airport-side hotel, 7.8 km from Chennai Airport. VAPR Ashok Nagar (30 rooms) is the city-side hotel, 850 m from Ashok Nagar Metro and 2.6 km from T. Nagar. Breakfast and Wi-Fi are included at both.

## Properties

- [VAPR Guindy](https://vaprrooms.com/guindy): 4, 4th Cross Street, Kalaimagal Nagar, Ekkatuthangal, Guindy, Chennai 600032. 16 Deluxe rooms, each with a queen bed or two single beds. Gym, indoor parking, lift, pantry, ironing boards, 24-hour security, cab on request (charged). 7.8 km from Chennai Airport, 2.1 km from Ashok Pillar, 3.3 km from MIOT International, 4.1 km from Kauvery Hospital, 5.4 km from Guindy Station, 5.6 km from Phoenix Marketcity, 8.6 km from Chennai Central. Guest rating 4.0 from 377 guests on Treebo.
- [VAPR Ashok Nagar](https://vaprrooms.com/ashok-nagar): 59/31, 46th Street, Sarvamangala Colony, Ashok Nagar, Chennai 600083. 30 rooms as single, double or triple occupancy (maximum three guests per room). Outdoor parking, lift, room service. 850 m from Ashok Nagar Metro, 2.6 km from T. Nagar, 2.6 km from SIIMS Hospital, 2.9 km from Forum Mall, 3.4 km from Pondy Bazaar, 4.3 km from Olympia Tech Park, 9 km from Chennai Airport, 10 km from Chennai Central. Guest rating 4.1 from 168 guests on Treebo.

## True of both hotels

- Check-in from 1.00 pm, check-out by 11.00 am. Early check-in depends on availability; give the desk a day's notice.
- Included: Wi-Fi, breakfast (idli, pongal, toast, filter coffee), branded toiletries.
- Lunch and dinner on a pre-order basis. No swimming pool. No laundry service.
- Every room has air conditioning, a work desk and chair, a wardrobe, a television with DTH, a geyser and an intercom.
- Air-conditioned lobby and a meeting room at both.
